zh-CN.headlineFact: 关税、AI执行与公共记忆进入落地期
zh-CN.headlineView: 规则正在变成经营与社会的日常系统
zh-CN.headlineFull: 关税、AI执行与公共记忆进入落地期；规则正在变成经营与社会的日常系统
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟小包裹关税、AI透明执法、单成员公司合规、空间站维护、广岛和平纪念、月球撞击观测、母乳喂养支持与高温韧性共同显示：世界正从宣布转向执行。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 长期韧性来自可执行的规则、可维护的设施与不被遗忘的经验。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 地图上的每个点，最后都要连到真实生活。

en-US.headlineFact: Duties, AI enforcement and public memory move into execution
en-US.headlineFull: Duties, AI enforcement and public memory move into execution; rules become everyday operating systems
en-US.intro: EU parcel duties, AI transparency enforcement, solo-company compliance, station maintenance, Hiroshima remembrance, lunar observing, breastfeeding support and heat resilience show a shift from announcements to execution.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Durable resilience comes from enforceable rules, maintainable infrastructure and experience that is not forgotten.
en-US.doudouQuote: Every point on the map must eventually connect to real life.

sources.title: Guidance and legal text on temporary flat fee on low-value imports
Commission opens consultation on draft guidelines for AI transparency obligations

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟3欧元小包裹关税进入首个完整月
zh-CN.headlineView: 商品分类与合单策略成为利润变量
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟3欧元小包裹关税进入首个完整月；商品分类与合单策略成为利润变量
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟自7月起对低于150欧元、直寄消费者的小包裹按商品类别征收3欧元关税；卖家需同步重算申报数据、客单价、拆包与履约路线。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境经营要把税费、商品分类和履约结构放进同一张利润表。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 每个小包裹都多了一个必须算清的点。

en-US.headlineFact: EU parcel duty enters its first full month
en-US.headlineView: classification and consolidation become margin variables
en-US.headlineFull: EU parcel duty enters its first full month; classification and consolidation become margin variables
en-US.intro: The EU applies a EUR3 duty per item category to parcels under EUR150 sent directly to consumers, requiring sellers to recalculate declaration data, basket size, parcel structure and fulfillment routes.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Cross-border operators must put duty, classification and fulfillment structure into one margin model.
en-US.doudouQuote: Every small parcel now has another point that must be calculated.

sources.title: Guidance and legal text on temporary flat fee on low-value imports

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟AI透明规则进入执法首周
zh-CN.headlineView: 生成内容披露成为产品基础能力
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟AI透明规则进入执法首周；生成内容披露成为产品基础能力
zh-CN.intro: 自8月2日起，面向欧盟用户的部分AI交互以及生成或操纵内容需要更清晰的身份披露、标识与来源说明，监管团队开始跟踪落实。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 透明不是末端补水印，而是输出、界面和审计链共同承担的产品能力。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先说清内容从哪里来，再让它走得更远。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: EU AI transparency enters its first enforcement week
en-US.headlineView: disclosure becomes a core product capability
en-US.headlineFull: EU AI transparency enters its first enforcement week; disclosure becomes a core product capability
en-US.intro: From August 2, certain AI interactions and generated or manipulated content shown to EU users require clearer disclosure, marking and provenance as enforcement begins.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Transparency is not a final watermark; output, interface and audit trail must share the responsibility.
en-US.doudouQuote: Say where content came from before sending it farther.

sources.title: Commission opens consultation on draft guidelines for AI transparency obligations

zh-CN.headlineFact: 单成员LLC需要分清税务身份
zh-CN.headlineView: 轻公司更需要模块化合规系统
zh-CN.headlineFull: 单成员LLC需要分清税务身份；轻公司更需要模块化合规系统
zh-CN.intro: 美国税局说明，单成员LLC通常按忽略实体处理，但雇佣税和部分消费税仍以独立实体申报；经营者需分清账户、税种、合同与责任。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司越轻，记录、申报和责任边界越要提前模块化。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 老板可以只有一个，账务节点不能糊成一团。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: Single-member LLCs must separate tax identities
en-US.headlineFull: Single-member LLCs must separate tax identities; lean companies need modular compliance
en-US.intro: The IRS says a single-member LLC is usually disregarded for income tax, while employment and certain excise taxes still use separate-entity treatment.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The leaner the company, the earlier records, filings and responsibility boundaries should be modularized.
en-US.doudouQuote: One owner is fine; accounting nodes cannot blur together.

zh-CN.headlineFact: NASA启动8月空间站维护太空行走
zh-CN.headlineView: 长期探索靠持续检修而非一次发射
zh-CN.headlineFull: NASA启动8月空间站维护太空行走；长期探索靠持续检修而非一次发射
zh-CN.intro: NASA计划在8月安排多次美国太空行走，首场于8月6日展开，任务围绕空间站外部维护与升级，体现轨道基础设施的日常运营。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 太空探索的可靠性，来自一次次可验证、可维护的工程动作。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 飞得再远，也得按时拧紧下一颗螺丝。

en-US.headlineView: long exploration depends on continuous repair
en-US.headlineFull: NASA begins August station-maintenance spacewalks; long exploration depends on continuous repair
en-US.intro: NASA plans multiple U.S. spacewalks in August, beginning August 6, focused on external station maintenance and upgrades.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Reliable exploration comes from engineering work that can be verified and maintained.
en-US.doudouQuote: However far we fly, the next bolt still needs tightening.

sources.title: Indian-origin astronaut Anil Menon set for first spacewalk

zh-CN.headlineFact: 广岛原爆81周年纪念呼吁守住和平
zh-CN.headlineView: 历史记忆仍是核风险时代的公共基础设施
zh-CN.headlineFull: 广岛原爆81周年纪念呼吁守住和平；历史记忆仍是核风险时代的公共基础设施
zh-CN.intro: 8月6日，广岛举行原爆81周年纪念活动。幸存者记忆与和平教育提醒世界，核武器造成的人道后果必须持续进入公共决策。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 记忆不是停在过去，而是帮助今天的人识别不可承受的风险。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把每个名字记住，和平才不只是一个口号。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：和平与记忆。

en-US.headlineFact: Hiroshima marks 81 years and renews its call for peace
en-US.headlineFull: Hiroshima marks 81 years and renews its call for peace; historical memory remains public infrastructure
en-US.intro: On August 6, Hiroshima marks 81 years since the atomic bombing, keeping survivor testimony and the humanitarian consequences of nuclear weapons in public decision-making.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Memory does not stop in the past; it helps people today recognize unbearable risks.
en-US.doudouQuote: Remember every name so peace is more than a slogan.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 废弃火箭级撞月成为科学观测窗口
zh-CN.headlineView: 可预报撞击也提醒深空碎片责任
zh-CN.headlineFull: 废弃火箭级撞月成为科学观测窗口；可预报撞击也提醒深空碎片责任
zh-CN.intro: 研究团队围绕8月5日猎鹰9号废弃上面级撞击月球安排闪光与喷出物观测，同时推动对深空物体追踪和处置责任的讨论。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 能准确预测的残骸事件可以成为实验，也应成为治理案例。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 旧火箭留下的不只一个坑，还有一张责任清单。

en-US.headlineFact: Spent rocket impact becomes a lunar observing window
en-US.headlineView: a predictable impact also raises debris responsibility
en-US.headlineFull: Spent rocket impact becomes a lunar observing window; a predictable impact also raises debris responsibility
en-US.intro: Researchers planned observations of the August 5 Falcon 9 upper-stage lunar impact, using its flash and ejecta as a scientific opportunity while highlighting deep-space tracking.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A predictable debris event can be both an experiment and a governance case.
en-US.doudouQuote: The old rocket leaves not only a crater, but a responsibility list.

sources.title: Observational planning for the 2026 August 5 Falcon 9 Upper Stage lunar impact

zh-CN.headlineFact: 世界母乳喂养周强调持续支持
zh-CN.headlineView: 医疗、工作与社区需要连成服务网络
zh-CN.headlineFull: 世界母乳喂养周强调持续支持；医疗、工作与社区需要连成服务网络
zh-CN.intro: 2026年世界母乳喂养周于8月1日至7日举行，WHO强调把已证实有效的支持嵌入医疗、工作场所与社区，让家庭获得连续帮助。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 公共健康倡议要从一周传播变成全年可获得的服务。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 支持不是一个点，而是一条不断线的路。

en-US.headlineFact: World Breastfeeding Week emphasizes continuous support
en-US.headlineView: health care, workplaces and communities must connect
en-US.headlineFull: World Breastfeeding Week emphasizes continuous support; health care, workplaces and communities must connect
en-US.intro: World Breastfeeding Week 2026 runs August 1–7, with WHO emphasizing proven support across health care, workplaces and communities.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A public-health campaign should turn one week of attention into year-round accessible support.
en-US.doudouQuote: Support is not one point; it is a path that stays connected.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 未来五年至少一年破高温纪录概率达80%
zh-CN.headlineView: 高温韧性需要进入长期预算
zh-CN.headlineFull: 未来五年至少一年破高温纪录概率达80%；高温韧性需要进入长期预算
zh-CN.intro: WMO估计2025至2029年至少一年超过2024年最热纪录的概率为80%，城市、能源与企业需要把极端高温准备从应急转为常态投资。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当高温成为高概率事件，韧性就必须写进每年的预算与运营。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 不能每次热浪来临，才第一次打开应急预案。

en-US.headlineFact: Record heat in at least one of five years is 80% likely
en-US.headlineView: heat resilience belongs in long-term budgets
en-US.headlineFull: Record heat in at least one of five years is 80% likely; heat resilience belongs in long-term budgets
en-US.intro: WMO estimates an 80% chance that at least one year from 2025 to 2029 will surpass 2024 as the warmest on record.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When extreme heat becomes probable, resilience must enter annual budgets and operations.
en-US.doudouQuote: Do not open the heat plan for the first time during the heatwave.

sources.title: WMO Global Annual to Decadal Climate Update (2025-2029)
